title: Ollama
description: Run any Ollama model or Hugging Face GGUF repo on serverless. Works with Runpod model caching, chat and completion requests, streaming, tool calling, and model caching on network volumes.

input.name: Hugging Face GGUF Repo
input.description: Hugging Face repo containing GGUF files, e.g. 'unsloth/Qwen3-8B-GGUF'. A 'hf.co/<org>/<repo>' form, a full huggingface.co URL, and a trailing ':<quant>' tag are all accepted and normalised. NOT the same field as 'Ollama Model': that one takes an Ollama model name, this takes a Hugging Face repo id. When both are set, this one wins and 'Ollama Model' is ignored. Also separate from the endpoint's own Model field, which controls Runpod's model caching. Must be a GGUF repo -- safetensors-only repos are rejected with an error. Set the endpoint's Model field to this same repo so Runpod's model store pre-downloads it for free.

input.name: Quantization (Optional)
input.description: Which GGUF quantization to load from the Hugging Face repo, e.g. 'Q4_K_M', 'Q8_0', 'IQ4_XS', 'BF16'. Optional: when left empty, a ':<quant>' tag on the repo above is used if present, otherwise the smallest GGUF in the repo, which is the fastest to load but the lowest quality. Set it explicitly to control quality and VRAM use. Ignored unless 'Hugging Face GGUF Repo' is set.

input.name: Ollama Model (Optional)
input.description: Ollama model to pull at startup. Any Ollama library model (e.g. 'llama3.2:3b') or an Ollama-style HuggingFace reference with a quant tag (e.g. 'hf.co/prism-ml/Bonsai-27B-gguf:Q1_0'). Ignored when 'Hugging Face GGUF Repo' is set. If both are left empty the worker falls back to 'llama3.2:3b'.

input.name: Hugging Face Token
input.description: Hugging Face access token, required only for gated or private models. This is separate from the Hugging Face token you enter in the endpoint's Model Caching settings: that one is used by Runpod for the pre-download, this one is used by the worker when it has to fetch the model itself. Leave empty for public models.

input.name: GGUF Filename
input.description: Exact .gguf path inside the Hugging Face repo, e.g. 'Qwen3-8B-Q4_K_M.gguf'. Escape hatch for repos where the quantization name matches several files. Overrides 'Quantization'. For a multi-part GGUF, name any shard and all of them are loaded.

input.name: Model Store Path
input.description: Where Runpod's model caching places the pre-downloaded Hugging Face cache. Only change this if Runpod changes the mount path.

input.name: Chat Template Override
input.description: Ollama Go template used when registering a Hugging Face GGUF. Leave empty to use the template embedded in the GGUF. Set this only if chat output looks malformed.

input.name: Context Length
input.description: Context window size in tokens. Larger values use more VRAM.

input.name: KV Cache Type
input.description: Quantization type for the KV cache. q8_0 and q4_0 reduce VRAM usage at some quality cost. Requires Flash Attention.

input.name: Flash Attention
input.description: Enable flash attention. Reduces VRAM usage and is required for KV cache quantization.

input.name: Num Parallel
input.description: Number of requests processed in parallel per loaded model. Increases VRAM usage per parallel slot.

input.name: Max Loaded Models
input.description: Maximum number of models loaded into VRAM at the same time.

input.name: Keep Alive
input.description: How long a model stays loaded after a request (e.g. '5m', '24h'). '-1' keeps it loaded for the lifetime of the worker (recommended for serverless).

input.name: Max Queue
input.description: Maximum number of queued requests before Ollama rejects new ones.

input.name: Load Timeout
input.description: Maximum time Ollama waits for a model to load into memory before failing the request (e.g. '10m', '60m'). Defaults to 60m so a large model loading on a fresh worker is not killed by Ollama's built-in 5m limit; only lower it if you want faster failure on misconfigured models.

input.name: GPU Spread
input.description: Spread a model across all GPUs instead of loading it on a single GPU. Only relevant for multi-GPU workers.

input.name: Debug Logging
input.description: Enable verbose Ollama server logs for troubleshooting.
